_note: svelte-check maps diagnostics through a snapshot that prepends the script's leading `// @ts-check` / `// @ts-nocheck` line to the generated code, while the offsets come from the file tsgo checked, which has no such line; every diagnostic of the component therefore lands that many characters (13 or 15) earlier. The directive itself sits inside the render function, so `@ts-nocheck` suppresses nothing. Verified against svelte-check --tsgo.
